1.title: Festival honouring Dolly Parton set for Nashville and London
1.summary: Dolly Parton's estate says DollyFest will take the place of a traditional public memorial for the artist, just as she wanted.

2.title: Two dead and more than a dozen missing after 'terrifying' flash flood hits Grand Canyon
2.summary: "It was a beautiful day - and then people were screaming," one hiker tells the BBC, as 14 people are missing.

3.title: Death Toll Rises in Grand Canyon Flood as Search Efforts Continue
3.summary: Officials announced a second death and said that more than a dozen people remain unaccounted for after heavy rain.

4.title: For Nepal’s Young Leader, Flood Recovery Will Be a Herculean Task
4.summary: Prime Minister Balendra Shah, 36, rose to power this year on the back of youth anger with graft and mismanagement. His fledgling government now faces a huge test.

5.title: Summit With Russia, India and Iran Shows Leverage Wars Have Given Xi of China
5.summary: A two-day conference of the 10-nation Shanghai Cooperation Organization in Kyrgyzstan shows the limits of U.S. economic warfare.

6.title: Lionel Messi’s Retirement From Soccer Sparks Heartbreak Across Argentina
6.summary: Lionel Messi’s retirement from the national soccer team, though widely expected, sparked fears of a diminished squad, and heartbreak over the departure of a national icon.
